mapper.select: select batch_no from b_qifu_save_reach_delete_record_api_push_log where api_code = '${apiCode}' and push_date = '${pushDate}' order by create_time desc, update_time desc, batch_no desc limit 1

select resp_flag, resp_code, resp_msg, sync_applet_date, push_date, count(*) as status from b_qifu_save_reach_delete_record_api_push_log where api_code = '${apiCode}' and push_date = '${pushDate}' and status = 2 and resp_flag = 'F' group by resp_msg;

select qifu_is_succeed, qifu_message, sync_applet_date, push_date, count(*) as status from b_qifu_save_reach_delete_record_api_push_log where api_code = '${apiCode}' and push_date = '${pushDate}' and status = 2 and qifu_is_succeed = 'N' group by qifu_message;

select error_msg, sync_applet_date, push_date, count(*) as status from b_qifu_save_reach_delete_record_api_push_log where api_code = '${apiCode}' and push_date = '${pushDate}' and status = 2 group by error_msg;
